```{r}
# Read SLD NYC file (the one that has TRACT_GEOID and ZIP)
sld <- read.csv("sld_ny_city_with_zips.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Basic structure
str(sld)[1:10]

# check that TRACT_GEOID and ZIP exist
stopifnot("TRACT_GEOID" %in% names(sld))
stopifnot("ZIP" %in% names(sld))

# Coerce to character (avoid scientific notation issues)
sld$TRACT_GEOID <- as.character(sld$TRACT_GEOID)
sld$ZIP <- as.character(sld$ZIP)

# Check lengths of GEOIDs
table(nchar(sld$TRACT_GEOID))

# Peek at a few rows
head(sld[, c("TRACT_GEOID", "countyName", "ZIP")])
length(unique(sld$TRACT_GEOID))
length(unique(sld$ZIP))


```

```{r}
# Download NY state tracts (sf)
ny_tracts <- tracts(state = "NY", year = 2020, class = "sf")

# GEOID is the 11-digit tract ID
str(ny_tracts$GEOID)

# Restrict to NYC counties via COUNTYFP (Bronx=005, Kings=047, New York=061, Queens=081, Richmond=085)
nyc_counties <- c("005", "047", "061", "081", "085")
nyc_tracts <- ny_tracts[ny_tracts$COUNTYFP %in% nyc_counties, ]

nrow(nyc_tracts)   # how many tracts

```

```{r}
# Use the deduplicated SLD one ZIP per tract
sld_zip <- sld[, c("TRACT_GEOID", "ZIP", "countyName")]
sld_zip$TRACT_GEOID <- as.character(sld_zip$TRACT_GEOID)
sld_zip$ZIP <- as.character(sld_zip$ZIP)

# drop rows with missing ZIP
sld_zip <- sld_zip[!is.na(sld_zip$ZIP) & sld_zip$ZIP != "", ]

# if a tract has multiple ZIPs, keep the first
sld_zip <- sld_zip[!duplicated(sld_zip$TRACT_GEOID), ]

nrow(sld_zip) # tracts that now have exactly one ZIP
length(unique(sld_zip$ZIP))

# Merge onto NYC tracts
nyc_tracts_merged <- merge(
  nyc_tracts,
  sld_zip[, c("TRACT_GEOID", "ZIP")],
  by.x = "GEOID",
  by.y = "TRACT_GEOID",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Check ZIP coverage and uniqueness
sum(is.na(nyc_tracts_merged$ZIP))      # tracts with no ZIP
length(unique(nyc_tracts_merged$ZIP))  # unique ZIPs
length(unique(nyc_tracts_merged$GEOID)) == nrow(nyc_tracts_merged)  # TRUE = no duplication

```


```{r}
# Load cleaned arrests
arrests_clean <- read.csv("NYPD_Arrests_Clean.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# check coordinates
summary(arrests_clean$Latitude)
summary(arrests_clean$Longitude)

# Filter to valid coords
arrests_xy <- arrests_clean[
  !is.na(arrests_clean$Latitude) &
    !is.na(arrests_clean$Longitude) &
    !(arrests_clean$Latitude == 0 & arrests_clean$Longitude == 0),
]

nrow(arrests_xy)

# Convert to sf points (WGS84)
arrests_sf <- st_as_sf(
  arrests_xy,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326
)

# Transform both to same CRS (use tracts' CRS)
nyc_tracts_merged <- st_transform(nyc_tracts_merged, 2263)  # NY State Plane as example
arrests_sf <- st_transform(arrests_sf, st_crs(nyc_tracts_merged))

# Spatial join
# Assign each arrest the ZIP from the tract it falls in
arrests_with_zip_sf <- st_join(arrests_sf, nyc_tracts_merged["ZIP"])

# Drop geometry back to data.frame
arrests_with_zip <- as.data.frame(st_drop_geometry(arrests_with_zip_sf))

# How many arrests got a ZIP
sum(!is.na(arrests_with_zip$ZIP))
sum(is.na(arrests_with_zip$ZIP))

# Drop arrests without ZIPs
arrests_with_zip <- arrests_with_zip[!is.na(arrests_with_zip$ZIP), ]


```

```{r}
# Clean up weird values
arrests_with_zip$LAW_CAT_CD[arrests_with_zip$LAW_CAT_CD %in% c("", "9", "I")] <- NA

# Total arrests per ZIP
crime_zip <- aggregate(
  ARREST_KEY ~ ZIP,
  data = arrests_with_zip,
  FUN = length
)
names(crime_zip)[names(crime_zip) == "ARREST_KEY"] <- "total_arrests_zip"

# Felony arrests per ZIP
crime_zip_fel <- aggregate(
  I(LAW_CAT_CD == "Felony") ~ ZIP,
  data = arrests_with_zip,
  FUN = function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
)
names(crime_zip_fel)[2] <- "felony_zip"

# Misdemeanor arrests per ZIP
crime_zip_mis <- aggregate(
  I(LAW_CAT_CD == "Misdemeanor") ~ ZIP,
  data = arrests_with_zip,
  FUN = function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
)
names(crime_zip_mis)[2] <- "misdemeanor_zip"

# Violation arrests per ZIP
crime_zip_viol <- aggregate(
  I(LAW_CAT_CD == "Violation") ~ ZIP,
  data = arrests_with_zip,
  FUN = function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
)
names(crime_zip_viol)[2] <- "violation_zip"

# Merge all crime summaries
crime_zip <- merge(crime_zip, crime_zip_fel, by = "ZIP", all = TRUE)
crime_zip <- merge(crime_zip, crime_zip_mis, by = "ZIP", all = TRUE)
crime_zip <- merge(crime_zip, crime_zip_viol, by = "ZIP", all = TRUE)

# Replace any remaining NAs with zero
crime_zip[is.na(crime_zip)] <- 0

head(crime_zip)
summary(crime_zip$total_arrests_zip)
summary(crime_zip$felony_zip)

```

```{r}
# Read clean 2017 property sales (sf object)
prop_2017_sf <- readRDS("clean_property_2017.rds")  # should be sf

# Check structure of real estate database
prop_2017_sf
str(prop_2017_sf)

# Make sure CRS matches tracts
prop_2017_sf <- st_transform(prop_2017_sf, st_crs(nyc_tracts_merged))

# Spatial join the properties to the tracts (with ZIP)
prop_with_zip_sf <- st_join(prop_2017_sf, nyc_tracts_merged["ZIP"])

prop_with_zip <- as.data.frame(st_drop_geometry(prop_with_zip_sf))

# How many properties have ZIP
sum(!is.na(prop_with_zip$ZIP))
sum(is.na(prop_with_zip$ZIP))

# Drop ones without ZIP
prop_with_zip <- prop_with_zip[!is.na(prop_with_zip$ZIP), ]

# Basic summary
summary(prop_with_zip$price)

```

```{r}
# Merge crime metrics onto property sales by ZIP
model_zip_df <- merge(
  prop_with_zip,
  crime_zip,
  by = "ZIP",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# NAs for crime get 0 0 (no recorded arrests)
model_zip_df$total_arrests_zip[is.na(model_zip_df$total_arrests_zip)] <- 0
model_zip_df$felony_zip[is.na(model_zip_df$felony_zip)] <- 0
model_zip_df$misdemeanor_zip[is.na(model_zip_df$misdemeanor_zip)] <- 0
model_zip_df$violation_zip[is.na(model_zip_df$violation_zip)] <- 0

# Create log price and log sqft
model_zip_df$log_price <- log(model_zip_df$price)
model_zip_df$log_tot_sqft <- log(model_zip_df$tot_sqft + 1)

# Simple plots
hist(model_zip_df$log_price, main = "Log Price", xlab = "log(price)")
hist(model_zip_df$total_arrests_zip, main = "Total Arrests per ZIP", xlab = "count")


```


```{r}
set.seed(160)
n <- nrow(model_zip_df)

idx <- sample(1:n, n)
train_n <- floor(0.7 * n)
valid_n <- floor(0.15 * n)

train_idx <- idx[1:train_n]
valid_idx <- idx[(train_n + 1):(train_n + valid_n)]
test_idx  <- idx[(train_n + valid_n + 1):n]

train <- model_zip_df[train_idx, ]
valid <- model_zip_df[valid_idx, ]
test  <- model_zip_df[test_idx, ]

nrow(train); nrow(valid); nrow(test)

```


```{r}
rmse <- function(y, p) {
  sqrt(mean((y - p)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

```

```{r}
mA <- lm(
  log_price ~ log_tot_sqft + yr_built + land_sqft + bldg_num_ctgy,
  data = train
)

summary(mA)

```

```{r}
mB <- lm(
  log_price ~ log_tot_sqft + yr_built + land_sqft + bldg_num_ctgy +
    factor(ZIP),
  data = train
)

summary(mB)$adj.r.squared

```

```{r}
mC <- lm(
  log_price ~ log_tot_sqft + yr_built + land_sqft + bldg_num_ctgy +
    total_arrests_zip,
  data = train
)

summary(mC)

```

```{r}
# Baseline
predA_valid <- predict(mA, newdata = valid)
predA_test  <- predict(mA, newdata = test)

rmseA_valid <- rmse(valid$log_price, predA_valid)
rmseA_test  <- rmse(test$log_price,  predA_test)

# Baseline + crime (no ZIP FE)
predC_valid <- predict(mC, newdata = valid)
predC_test  <- predict(mC, newdata = test)

rmseC_valid <- rmse(valid$log_price, predC_valid)
rmseC_test  <- rmse(test$log_price,  predC_test)

rmseA_valid; rmseC_valid
rmseA_test;  rmseC_test

```

```{r}
predC_test <- predict(mC, newdata = test)

ggplot(data.frame(
  actual = test$log_price,
  predicted = predC_test
), aes(x = actual, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted vs Actual Log Sale Price (Model C – baseline + crime)",
    x = "Actual log(price)",
    y = "Predicted log(price)"
  )

```
```{r}
library(randomForest)
# Prepare RF training dataframe
rf_train <- train[, c("log_price", "log_tot_sqft", "yr_built",
                      "land_sqft", "bldg_num_ctgy", "total_arrests_zip")]

rf_valid <- valid[, c("log_price", "log_tot_sqft", "yr_built",
                      "land_sqft", "bldg_num_ctgy", "total_arrests_zip")]

rf_test <- test[, c("log_price", "log_tot_sqft", "yr_built",
                    "land_sqft", "bldg_num_ctgy", "total_arrests_zip")]

# Random Forest Model A (this is the baseline)
set.seed(160)

rfA <- randomForest(
  log_price ~ log_tot_sqft + yr_built + land_sqft + bldg_num_ctgy,
  data = rf_train,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = 3,
  importance = TRUE
)

# Validation + Test predictions
rfA_pred_valid <- predict(rfA, newdata = rf_valid)
rfA_pred_test  <- predict(rfA, newdata = rf_test)

# RMSEs
rfA_valid_rmse <- rmse(rf_valid$log_price, rfA_pred_valid)
rfA_test_rmse  <- rmse(rf_test$log_price, rfA_pred_test)

rfA_valid_rmse
rfA_test_rmse

# Random Forest Model C (baseline + crime)
set.seed(160)

rfC <- randomForest(
  log_price ~ log_tot_sqft + yr_built + land_sqft + bldg_num_ctgy +
    total_arrests_zip,
  data = rf_train,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = 3,
  importance = TRUE
)

rfC_pred_valid <- predict(rfC, newdata = rf_valid)
rfC_pred_test  <- predict(rfC, newdata = rf_test)

rfC_valid_rmse <- rmse(rf_valid$log_price, rfC_pred_valid)
rfC_test_rmse  <- rmse(rf_test$log_price, rfC_pred_test)

rfC_valid_rmse
rfC_test_rmse


# Variable importance plots
varImpPlot(rfA, main = "RF Baseline – Variable Importance")
varImpPlot(rfC, main = "RF Crime Model – Variable Importance")

```
